title: Viva Wewa — Kinshasa en mouvement
description_fr: Illustration originale de marque : pilote adulte sur petite moto utilitaire, passagère, receveur de minibus, commerce de rue et fleuve Congo. Composition libre inspirée de Kinshasa, à relire localement ; elle ne représente pas un lieu cartographié exact.

provenance.notes_fr: Création originale commandée pour Viva Wewa. Aucun logo GTA/Rockstar, personnage existant ni photographie incorporée. Le pont inventé sur le fleuve a été retiré par une passe d'édition.

prompts.initial: Create one original premium video game key-art illustration, landscape 16:9 composition, for an upcoming game about the spirited everyday life and motorcycle riding of Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo. NO TEXT, NO LETTERING, NO WATERMARKS, NO LOGOS. Strong bold ink outlines, expressive hand-painted flat-color shapes and richly shaded painted faces, cinematic poster collage, energetic satirical urban action-game cover illustration aesthetic. Original characters only. Optimistic, warm, mischievous daily life, NO WEAPONS, NO VIOLENCE. Central foreground right: charismatic adult Black Congolese male motorcycle taxi rider, about 28, short hair, warm confident smile, wearing a well fitted orange reflective moto-taxi vest over a cobalt shirt, dark practical trousers and a simple motorcycle helmet with visor up. He is riding a realistic modest small utility commuter motorcycle, 100–125cc, slender frame, circular headlamp, narrow fuel tank, black single cylinder engine, long black two-person bench seat, practical rear luggage rack, wire-spoked wheels, chrome front fork and chrome exhaust; realistic scale, believable mechanics, both wheels aligned, not a racing superbike, no luxury motorcycle. Camera low three-quarter view, complete front wheel and most motorcycle visible in lower central foreground. Behind him, layer a yellow shared taxi, weathered yellow-and-blue city minibus with side sliding door open, jovial adult Black Congolese bus receiver leaning safely in open side door calling destinations with one arm gesturing upwards. Small groups of everyday pedestrians, including women in bright patterned pagne dresses carrying bags, walking by neighborhood shops and a fruit stand; a few Congolese palm trees. Background shows a lively authentic Kinshasa avenue, aged concrete low-rise buildings, utility wires, broad Congo River visible beyond the skyline, haze and warm tropical sunlight. Urban unpaved side-road details include puddles, uneven sandy earth, a shallow open drain, all subtle. Vibrant mango yellow, coral orange, electric cobalt blue with deep navy shadows, lush tropical green accents, beautiful orange sky. Striking instantly readable silhouettes, tasteful detail and layered depth, hand-painted editorial illustration rather than photorealistic. Keep the upper-left 40 percent visually calm and relatively dark blue, with minimal shapes, clear of faces and important objects, so a title can later be placed as HTML over it. Main faces and motorcycle occupy right half and lower center. Illustration fills the entire canvas, no poster border. Render crisp high-resolution artwork.
prompts.correction: Edit this artwork with a very narrow correction. Preserve its illustration style, exact composition, all people, motorcycle, colorful buses, sun, sky, street, river, palette and lighting. Remove the entire cable-stayed suspension bridge from the upper right background and replace the bridge with uninterrupted broad Congo River water and a distant natural low riverbank. Kinshasa does not have such a bridge, so there must be NO BRIDGE anywhere in this image. Keep it a beautiful lively Kinshasa-inspired artwork and keep the whole original composition unchanged. Do not add text or logos. Preserve the dark blue open upper-left space for a future HTML title.

visual_review.corrected: Suppression du pont fictif sur le Congo.
remaining_limitations: Perspective et topographie artistiques, pas une reconstitution géographique.
Moto représentative d'une petite moto utilitaire ; conformité exacte aux références officielles à valider.
Absence de taxi séparé distinct : le minibus jaune/bleu est le véhicule de transport secondaire clairement visible.
